execution.id desc") #set($product = $services.query.hql($statement).bindValue("test", "${row.doc_space}.${row.doc_name}").setLimit(1).execute()) #if(!$product.isEmpty()) #set($statement = "select ") #end #set($discard = $row.put("distribution","$distributionsHTML")) #else #set($discard = $row.put("product", $services.localization.render('qaapp.WebHome.LiveTable.no.tests.execution.found'))) #set($discard = $row.put("browser", '')) #set($discard = $row.put("database", '')) #set($discard = $row.put("servletContainer", '')) #set($discard = $row.put("java", '')) #set($discard = $row.put("distribution", '')) #end #set($test = "${row.doc_space}.${row.doc_name}") #set($discard = $row.put("doc_runTest_url", $xwiki.getURL($row.doc_fullName, 'get', "sheet=QA.ExecutionAddSheet"))) ##ExtendRow Macro End #end #** * Removes the item at the given index from a list, in place. *# #macro(removeListItem $list $index) #set($keptItems = []) #foreach($listItem in $list) #if($foreach.index != $index) #set($discard = $keptItems.add($listItem)) #end #end #set($discard = $list.clear()) #set($discard = $list.addAll($keptItems)) #end #** * Removes what #gridresultwithfilter_buildQuery added to sort on a column computed from the latest execution (see * #filterAndSortByLatestExecution), which it took for a property of the object of each row (a QA.TestClass object, or * an object of the class given by the request parameter named after the column with a '_class' suffix): the joins and * their parameters, which are the last ones of $whereParams. The order clause is removed by the caller. *# #macro(removePlatformSort) #set($platformSortClauses = { ", ${tableName} ${safe_tableAlias}": " and ${orderObjectAlias}.id=${safe_tableAlias}.id.id and ${safe_tableAlias}.name = ?" }) #if($orderObjectAlias != 'obj') #set($discard = $platformSortClauses.put(", BaseObject ${orderObjectAlias}", " and ${orderObjectAlias}.name = doc.fullName and ${orderObjectAlias}.className = ?")) #end #set($removedParams = 0) #foreach($clause in $platformSortClauses.entrySet()) ## Only remove the parameter of a clause that is indeed there, so that the parameters stay aligned otherwise. #if($sql.contains($clause.value)) #set($sql = $sql.replace($clause.key, '').replace($clause.value, '')) #set($tagsMatchingFiltersFrom = $tagsMatchingFiltersFrom.replace($clause.key, '')) #set($tagsMatchingFiltersWhere = $tagsMatchingFiltersWhere.replace($clause.value, '')) #set($paramIndex = $whereParams.size() + 2 - $removedParams) #removeListItem($sqlParams $paramIndex) #removeListItem($tagsMatchingParams $paramIndex) #set($removedParams = $removedParams + 1) #end #end #end #** * Sets $versionOrderClauses to the order clauses, each preceded by a comma, comparing the version held by the given * field number by number (1 to 3 numbers), ignoring suffixes such as '-rc-1'. *# #macro(versionOrderClauses $versionField $direction) ## Keep only the numbers of the version: '18.7.0-rc-1', '18.7RC1' and '18.7 RC' become '18.7.0', '18.7' and '18.7'. #set($version = "lower($versionField)") #set($dashIndex = "locate('-', concat($version, '-'), 1)") #set($rcIndex = "locate('rc', concat($version, 'rc'), 1)") #set($numbers = "trim(both ' ' from substring($version, 1, (case when $dashIndex < $rcIndex then $dashIndex else $rcIndex end) - 1))") ## Pad to at least 3 numbers ('9.11' becomes '9.11.0.0.') so that each number is followed by a dot. #set($padded = "concat($numbers, '.0.0.')") #set($dot1 = "locate('.', $padded, 1)") #set($dot2 = "locate('.', $padded, $dot1 + 1)") #set($dot3 = "locate('.', $padded, $dot2 + 1)") #set($versionNumbers = ["substring($padded, 1, $dot1 - 1)", "substring($padded, $dot1 + 1, $dot2 - $dot1 - 1)", "substring($padded, $dot2 + 1, $dot3 - $dot2 - 1)"]) ## Numbers are compared by length first, then as strings, so that 9 < 10 without casting them (which would fail on ## unexpected values). #set($versionOrderClauses = '') #foreach($versionNumber in $versionNumbers) #set($versionOrderClauses = "$versionOrderClauses, length($versionNumber) $direction, $versionNumber $direction") #end #end #** * Sets $displayedLikeValues to the values of an environment column that #extendRow displays like the given filter * values: the pages of the environment class with the same name and, except for distributions, the same version. A * value that is not a page of that class is kept as is, since it is displayed as is. *# #macro(environmentsDisplayedLike $column $values) #set($displayedLikeValues = $collectiontool.orderedSet) #set($environmentClass = $environmentClasses.get($column)) #foreach($value in $values) #set($discard = $displayedLikeValues.add($value)) #set($environmentDoc = $xwiki.getDocument($value)) #set($environmentObject = $environmentDoc.getObject($environmentClass)) #if($environmentObject) #set($statement = "select distinct envObj.name from BaseObject envObj, StringProperty envName where envObj.className = :className and envName.id.id = envObj.id and envName.id.name = 'name' and envName.value = :name") #set($sameNamePages = $services.query.hql($statement).bindValue('className', $environmentClass).bindValue('name', "$!environmentObject.getProperty('name').value").execute()) #foreach($sameNamePage in $sameNamePages) #set($sameNameDoc = $xwiki.getDocument($sameNamePage)) ## Compare the versions the way #extendRow displays them. #if($column == 'distribution' || $sameNameDoc.get('version') == $environmentDoc.get('version')) #set($discard = $displayedLikeValues.add($sameNamePage)) #end #end #end #end #end #** * Filters and orders the query built by #gridresultwithfilter_buildQuery on the columns computed from the latest * execution of each test, which are not QA.TestClass properties: like in #extendRow, the latest execution is the most * recent QA.ExecutionClass object of the test (the one with the highest id among the most recent ones), and its product * is the latest product tested. * The product filter keeps the tests whose latest product is one of the filter values, and the product order is on the * product version. The filter of an environment column (browser, database, etc.) keeps the tests with at least one * execution of their latest product on one of the filter values, expanded by #environmentsDisplayedLike before this * macro is called. The order of an environment column is on the environment of the latest * execution: its name, then its version. Versions are compared with #versionOrderClauses. * The filter values are in $filterValuesByColumn and the sorted column is $sortColumn (empty when none of them). *# #macro(filterAndSortByLatestExecution) #if($orderSql != '') #set($sql = $stringtool.removeEnd($sql, " $orderSql")) #end #if($sortColumn != '') #removePlatformSort() #end ## ## Join the product of the latest execution. Left joins keep the tests that have no execution. The subqueries have ## join conditions and no where clause because query filters (e.g. 'hidden') insert their clause after the first where ## of the statement. #set($latestDate = "select max(d2.value) from BaseObject o2 join StringProperty t2 on t2.id.id = o2.id and t2.id.name = 'test' and t2.value = doc.fullName and o2.className = 'QA.ExecutionClass' join DateProperty d2 on d2.id.id = o2.id and d2.id.name = 'date'") #set($latestExecution = "select max(o1.id) from BaseObject o1 join StringProperty t1 on t1.id.id = o1.id and t1.id.name = 'test' and t1.value = doc.fullName and o1.className = 'QA.ExecutionClass' join DateProperty d1 on d1.id.id = o1.id and d1.id.name = 'date' and d1.value = ($latestDate)") #set($filterJoins = "left join StringProperty qaProduct on qaProduct.id.name = 'product' and qaProduct.id.id = ($latestExecution)") ## Join the version of the product, or the environment of the latest execution with its name and version. #set($sortJoins = '') #if($sortColumn == 'product') #set($sortJoins = " left join BaseObject qaProductObj on qaProductObj.name = qaProduct.value and qaProductObj.className = 'QA.ProductClass' left join StringProperty qaVersion on qaVersion.id.id = qaProductObj.id and qaVersion.id.name = 'version'") #elseif($sortColumn != '') #set($sortJoins = " left join StringProperty qaEnv on qaEnv.id.id = qaProduct.id.id and qaEnv.id.name = '$sortColumn' left join BaseObject qaEnvObj on qaEnvObj.name = qaEnv.value and qaEnvObj.className = '$environmentClasses.get($sortColumn)' left join StringProperty qaEnvName on qaEnvName.id.id = qaEnvObj.id and qaEnvName.id.name = 'name'") #if($sortColumn != 'distribution') #set($sortJoins = "$sortJoins left join StringProperty qaEnvVersion on qaEnvVersion.id.id = qaEnvObj.id and qaEnvVersion.id.name = 'version'") #end #end #set($sql = $stringtool.replaceOnce($sql, ', BaseObject as obj ', ", BaseObject as obj $filterJoins$sortJoins ")) ## #set($latestExecutionFilter = '') #set($latestExecutionFilterParams = []) #foreach($columnFilter in $filterValuesByColumn.entrySet()) #set($placeholders = []) #foreach($value in $columnFilter.value) #set($discard = $placeholders.add('?')) #end #set($placeholders = $stringtool.join($placeholders, ', ')) #if($columnFilter.key == 'product') #set($latestExecutionFilter = "$latestExecutionFilter and qaProduct.value in ($placeholders)") #else ## Look for the filter values in all the executions of the latest product of the test. #set($latestExecutionFilter = "$latestExecutionFilter and exists (select e.id from BaseObject e, StringProperty eTest, StringProperty eProduct, StringProperty eEnv where e.className = 'QA.ExecutionClass' and eTest.id.id = e.id and eTest.id.name = 'test' and eTest.value = doc.fullName and eProduct.id.id = e.id and eProduct.id.name = 'product' and eProduct.value = qaProduct.value and eEnv.id.id = e.id and eEnv.id.name = '$columnFilter.key' and eEnv.value in ($placeholders))") #end #set($discard = $latestExecutionFilterParams.addAll($columnFilter.value)) #end #if($latestExecutionFilter != '') #set($sql = "$sql$latestExecutionFilter") #set($discard = $sqlParams.addAll($latestExecutionFilterParams)) #set($tagsMatchingFiltersFrom = $stringtool.replaceOnce($tagsMatchingFiltersFrom, ', BaseObject as obj ', ", BaseObject as obj $filterJoins ")) #set($tagsMatchingFiltersWhere = "$tagsMatchingFiltersWhere$latestExecutionFilter") #set($discard = $tagsMatchingParams.addAll($latestExecutionFilterParams)) #end ## #set($direction = 'asc') #if($orderDirection == 'desc') #set($direction = 'desc') #end #if($sortColumn == 'product') ## Tests without execution come last. #versionOrderClauses('qaVersion.value' $direction) #set($sql = "$sql order by case when qaVersion.value is null then 1 else 0 end$versionOrderClauses, doc.fullName") #elseif($sortColumn != '') ## Tests without execution come last. The name of the environment is the value of the execution property when it ## is not an environment page. #set($sql = "$sql order by case when qaProduct.id.id is null then 1 else 0 end, lower(coalesce(qaEnvName.value, qaEnv.value)) $direction") #if($sortColumn != 'distribution') #versionOrderClauses('qaEnvVersion.value' $direction) #set($sql = "$sql$versionOrderClauses") #end #set($sql = "$sql, doc.fullName") #elseif($orderSql != '') #set($sql = "$sql $orderSql") #end #end #**# #if($xcontext.action == 'get' && "$!{request.outputSyntax}" == 'plain') $response.setContentType('application/json') #set($map = {}) #set($filterWhere = '') #set($filterParams = []) #if("$!request.testSpace" != '' || $request.testSpace == '') #set($filterWhere = "and doc.space = ?") #set($discard = $filterParams.add($request.testSpace)) #end ## ## ## Same as #gridresultwithfilter_buildJSON, with a custom filter and order for the columns computed from the latest ## execution. #gridresult_buildRowsJSON reads $className and $collist, which are the arguments of ## #gridresultwithfilter_buildJSON and are thus not defined here. #set($className = 'QA.TestClass') #set($collist = ['doc.title', 'doc.space', 'automated', 'status','deprecated', 'userType', 'wikiType']) #gridresultwithfilter_buildQuery($className $collist '' $filterWhere $filterParams) ## The environment columns, which are QA.ExecutionClass properties, with the class of the pages they reference. #set($environmentClasses = { 'browser': 'QA.BrowserClass', 'database': 'QA.DatabaseClass', 'servletContainer': 'QA.ServletContainerClass', 'java': 'QA.JavaClass', 'distribution': 'QA.DistributionClass' }) #set($latestExecutionColumns = ['product']) #set($discard = $latestExecutionColumns.addAll($environmentClasses.keySet())) #set($filterValuesByColumn = {}) #foreach($column in $latestExecutionColumns) #set($columnFilterValues = []) #foreach($value in $request.getParameterValues($column)) #if("$!value" != '') #set($discard = $columnFilterValues.add($value)) #end #end #if(!$columnFilterValues.isEmpty() && $environmentClasses.containsKey($column)) #environmentsDisplayedLike($column $columnFilterValues) #set($columnFilterValues = $displayedLikeValues) #end #if(!$columnFilterValues.isEmpty()) #set($discard = $filterValuesByColumn.put($column, $columnFilterValues)) #end #end #set($sortColumn = '') #if($latestExecutionColumns.contains("$!request.sort")) #set($sortColumn = $request.sort) #end #if($sortColumn != '' || !$filterValuesByColumn.isEmpty()) #filterAndSortByLatestExecution() #end #if("$!request.sql" == '1') #set($discard = $map.put('sql', $sql)) #set($discard = $map.put('params', $sqlParams)) #end #set($discard = $map.put('reqNo', $numbertool.toNumber($request.reqNo).intValue())) #if("$!request.tagcloud" == 'true') #gridresult_buildTagCloudJSON($map) #end #gridresult_buildRowsJSON($map) ## The environment icons are attached to QA.LiveTableResultsFullDetailed. #set($iconsDoc = $xwiki.getDocument('QA.LiveTableResultsFullDetailed')) #foreach ($row in $map.rows) #extendRow($row) #end $jsontool.serialize($map) #else Custom LiveTableResults page used for computing the results for the LiveTables used from QA.WebHome and from the WebHome of the Test Spaces #end {{/velocity}}
